stem: Scouting is performed only on the aisle-facing leaves at the same easy-to-reach plants each week. What is the strongest improvement?
choices: Increase fertilizer strength so hidden pests become visible
Use a defined sampling pattern that represents multiple zones, canopy positions, and likely entry or hotspot areas
Scout fewer plants but spend longer on each aisle-facing leaf
Record only positive findings so the log stays short
rationale: A representative, repeatable scouting design reduces sampling bias and improves the chance of detecting spatially uneven pest or disease problems.
